SELECT p.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit FROM scm_price_control p JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id
m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY m.code

SELECT o.id AS "orderId", o.order_no AS "orderNo", o.order_date AS "orderDate", COALESCE(i.orig_price, i.price) AS "price", i.tax_rate AS "taxRate", i.qty AS "qty", o.currency AS "currency", o.exchange_rate AS "exchangeRate" FROM scm_order_item i JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.kind = #{kind} AND o.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND i.material_id = #{materialId} AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL', 'DONE', 'CLOSED') AND COALESCE(i.gift, 0) = 0 ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
